inputs.brief: evals/briefs/02-devtool-landing-en.md, cut at the judge-notes line

claims.claim: The first screen at both sizes shows: what it is (headline and one-line definition), the `npm install` command with a copy button, and Get started / Docs.
claims.evidence: desktop-01.png and mobile-01.png: the headline 'Your app's data lives on the device first.', the definition paragraph, the '$ npm install @driftless/client' block with a copy button (labelled 'Copy' on desktop, icon only on mobile), then the 'Get started' and 'Read the docs' buttons.

claims.claim: On desktop the code sample is in the first screen too; on mobile it comes right after.
claims.evidence: desktop-01.png: the notes.ts code window is on the right of the hero. mobile-01.png: the code window starts right below the stats row (lines 1–9) and continues at the top of mobile-02.png.

claims.claim: re-wrapped the long lines ... so the longest line is about 43 characters. That lets the same sample be read at 390 px without horizontal scrolling or soft-wrapping.
claims.evidence: mobile-01.png/mobile-02.png: all 18 numbered lines sit on one line each with no soft-wrap. The longest line (18, 'VALUES (${id}, ${body}, ${Date.now()})`;') fits in the width. facts.md: no horizontal overflow at 390.

claims.claim: Social proof is limited to the allowed stats (18.4k stars, 236 contributors, 1.2M npm downloads/month). The GitHub star count also appears next to the GitHub nav link.
claims.evidence: desktop-01.png: the hero stats row and 'GitHub 18.4k' in the nav. No logos or testimonials in any frame. On mobile the nav shows only a GitHub icon without the count (mobile-01.png).

claims.claim: Benchmarks are shown as three numbers with the stated setup (M3 MacBook Air, Chrome 140, OPFS) ... I did not add bars or comparisons against other databases.
claims.evidence: desktop-04.png and mobile-06.png: three cards (0.2 ms, 0.8 ms, 1.9 s) with the caption 'Setup: M3 MacBook Air · Chrome 140 · OPFS'. No bars or competitor comparison.

claims.claim: I added "pending changes survive restarts" to the offline-writes row
claims.evidence: desktop-03.png, Offline writes row, Driftless column: 'Built in; pending changes survive restarts'. The same text is in mobile-04.png.

claims.claim: Cloud Pro is visually emphasised as the middle managed option ... so there is no badge.
claims.evidence: desktop-05.png: the Cloud Pro card has a heavy dark border and the only filled black CTA, 'Start with Pro'. It carries no badge. mobile-08.png shows the same dark border and filled button.

claims.claim: The 1.4 release pill says "30% smaller bundle" on mobile (the shorter pill); the "What's new in 1.4" block states the facts in full, including 19 Aug 2026.
claims.evidence: mobile-01.png pill: 'Shapes GA · Bun · 30% smaller bundle'. desktop-01.png pill: 'Shapes are generally available · Bun support'. desktop-04.png and mobile-06.png: 'What's new in 1.4', 'Released 19 Aug 2026' and three items.

claims.claim: the "how it works" intro paragraph, the benchmark intro paragraph, the first step's mini-diagram, the feature icons and the closing CTA band are hidden below 760 px.
claims.evidence: mobile-02.png: the How it works heading goes straight into step 1, with no intro text and no diagram in step 1 (desktop-02.png has the diagram). mobile-06.png: no benchmark intro paragraph. mobile-04/05.png: feature cards have no icons. mobile-10.png: the FAQ runs straight into the footer with no CTA band (desktop-07.png has it).

claims.claim: all FAQ answers are shown open, and the three install methods are shown side by side, not in tabs.
claims.evidence: desktop-06/07.png: all 4 FAQ answers are expanded, and the npm, SPM and Gradle cards sit side by side in 3 columns. On mobile they are stacked (mobile-08/09.png), with no tabs.

claims.claim: warm "paper" background with faint contour lines ... one deep green accent and a lime highlight used only on dark surfaces.
claims.evidence: desktop-01.png: cream background with faint wavy lines, and 'first.' in deep green. Lime appears only on dark surfaces: benchmark units and bars (desktop-04.png), code-footer values, the CTA-band button (desktop-07.png) and the logo mark.

claims.claim: To keep all content within the reviewed 10 screens
claims.evidence: facts.md: mobile has 10 frames and a page height of 7973 px, and no page is truncated at 10 screens. mobile-10.png ends with the footer and '© 2026 Driftless Labs'.
